label: Ollama
description: Local Ollama gateway for Settings → LLMs. Point at your Ollama server URL (default http://localhost:11434). Install from Store → Gateways, then enable to show the Ollama row under Providers & Keys.

steps.title: Providers & Keys
steps.body: Ollama lives under Settings → LLMs. Open Providers & Keys to set your local Ollama URL (default http://localhost:11434).
